name: Menherafflesia: Flowering Abyss
original_name: メンヘラフレシア フラワリングアビス
source:
"Open your eyes. You can see the beautiful sky, right?"

As you spend your monotonic days, you unknowingly get lost in a poisonous flower garden. Let's make the colorful flowers bloom here now...

"Menherafflesia Flowering Abyss" is an ADV game where you choose one of five types of flowers to capture the affection of heroines with mental health issues.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2021/06/05/mfa/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
“睁开眼睛。看得见美丽的天空吧？”

过着单调日常的你，不知不觉间迷失在一座有毒的花园里。现在，就让缤纷的花朵在这里绽放吧……

《精神病大王花Flowering Abyss》是一款文字冒险游戏，你将从五种花朵中选择其一，赢得有着心理困扰的女主角们的芳心。

[译自[url=https://enoshima210.work/2021/06/05/mfa/]官方网站[/url]]
